criteria.name: Product specificity
criteria.notes: Current public UI is text-only and exposes no image, video or product-URL reference input. Structural fail for product affiliate.

criteria.name: Output quality
criteria.notes: Vendor demo and gallery do not substitute for saved AIVP outputs.

criteria.name: Control and consistency
criteria.notes: Resolution and 2–10 second duration are selectable; seeds, references and repeatability are unverified.

criteria.name: Workflow strength
criteria.notes: No-signup prompt-to-download flow is live, but it produces only short landscape clips and has no editor.

criteria.name: Speed and reliability
criteria.notes: Builder publishes single-GPU timings and queue design; AIVP has no timing or failure artifacts.

criteria.name: Cost efficiency
criteria.notes: Three free generations per IP per day are documented; paid redemption-code pricing and cost per accepted output are absent.

criteria.name: Commercial rights
criteria.notes: Service claims user ownership, but upstream H3 community-licence applicability and Australia-specific monetized use are unresolved.

criteria.name: Automation and integration
criteria.notes: Client code exposes JSON generation/status endpoints, but no supported API contract, auth, webhook or SLA exists.

criteria.name: AU creator/SMB fit
criteria.notes: Public browser access needs no account or card; geographic reliability and rights for Australia remain unclear.

criteria.name: Monetization fit
criteria.notes: No affiliate or partner programme found; AdSense intent is possible but unproven.

analysis: Marvis is a transparent, low-friction indie H3 service rather than a new model. The text-only interface structurally fails product-affiliate specificity; narrative usefulness and rights require testing and confirmation.
confidence_notes: Primary service/model documents and a vendor-authored technical account only; no AIVP run.

hard_gates.publication: Blocked until Australia-specific MiniMax H3 derivative/output rights are confirmed.
hard_gates.integration: Not started; undocumented endpoints require security and cost-gate audit before use.
